American National Bank Has Trimmed By $828,960 Its Facebook (FB) Stake; VIFOR PHARMA AG COMMON SHARES (GNHAF) Shorts Down By 6.77%
May 26, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
American National Bank decreased Facebook Inc (FB) stake by 14.1% reported in 2017Q4 SEC filing. American National Bank sold 4,710 shares as Facebook Inc (FB)’s stock declined 14.10%. The American National Bank holds 28,684 shares with $5.06M value, down from 33,394 last quarter. Facebook Inc now has $535.28 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 9.79M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
VIFOR PHARMA AG COMMON SHARES (OTCMKTS:GNHAF) had a decrease of 6.77% in short interest. GNHAF’s SI was 1.06M shares in May as released by FINRA. Its down 6.77% from 1.14 million shares previously. It closed at $137 lastly. It is down 0.00% since May 26, 2017 and is . It has underperformed by 11.55% the S&P500.
Vifor Pharma AG develops, manufactures, and distributes pharmaceutical products in Switzerland, rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company has market cap of $. The firm operates in three divisions: Vifor Pharma, Health & Beauty, and Services. It currently has negative earnings. It offers iron replacement products, including Ferinject/Injectafer, Venofer, Maltofer, and Velphoro; immuno-stimulant products, such as Broncho-Vaxom and Uro-Vaxom; and synthetic and biotech drugs for use in immunology, as well as for the treatment of infectious diseases.
